clue.text: Passage for legwear, say, of beast to be seen in due course?

definitions.text: beast to be seen in due course?

indicators.note: say tells us to hear the phrase spoken rather than read its spelling

parts.note: an alley is a narrow passage and a gaiter is a covering worn on the lower leg

explanation.surface: A riddle asking about a narrow passage for leggings and some creature you will meet again later.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on the farewell 'See you later, alligator': the beast is the one you will see in due course.
explanation.definitionFit: The playground parting rhyme makes this reptile the creature promised to be seen later on.

clue.text: A northern Briton, of course

parts.note: a Scot is a Briton from the north of the island

explanation.surface: A man from the north of Britain, naturally enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of course' reads as 'naturally', but 'course' is a racecourse: Ascot is the famous one in Berkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascot is a well-known English racecourse in Berkshire, so it is an example of a course.

clue.text: Determined on strike, being inflamed?

indicators.note: on signals one piece attached after the other in this charade

parts.note: to lam is to hit or thrash
bent on something means determined to do it

explanation.surface: A worker set on striking, all fired up about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Determined on strike' reads as a militant worker; in fact BENT is placed on LAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Lambent describes a flame flickering over a surface, so something glowing as if alight.

clue.text: The wooden horse, a horse said to be without smell if on top of things

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the horse letters go round the smell
said means the child's word for a horse is heard, giving two letters that sound like it

parts.note: gee-gee is a nursery word for a horse
reek means a strong smell
taken as written

indicators.note: top of picks the opening letter of things

explanation.surface: A rambling description of the Trojan horse as an odourless creature placed on top of everything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' has its old meaning 'outside'. 'on' puts IF before the T from 'top of things'.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek gift is a treacherous present, named after the wooden horse the Greeks left outside Troy.

clue.text: Hot spot — arrange kit and brush hat

indicators.note: arrange tells us to put the letters of the following words in a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions to tidy up some kit and brush down a hat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' joins the two pieces of fodder and gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A Turkish bath is a steam room, literally a hot place to sit and sweat.

clue.text: See 25
Skin disease raised after student goes to America

indicators.note: after sends the raised piece second, behind the student
goes to signals the last piece being added at the end

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate, standing for a student
up means raised
US is the United States

explanation.surface: A skin complaint flaring up after a student moves to the United States.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised after student' places UP after L.
explanation.definitionFit: Lupus is an autoimmune illness often marked by a red rash on the face and skin.

clue.text: One may be caught by this, as girl by love

definitions.text: One may be caught by this

indicators.note: by signals one piece placed beside the other

parts.note: a lass is a girl
love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone captured, like a girl captured by love.
explanation.definitionFit: A lasso is a looped rope thrown to catch cattle or horses.

clue.text: Perfect type of quiet home for Catherine

parts.note: p is piano, the musical term for quiet
Catherine of Aragon, first wife of Henry VIII, came from the Spanish kingdom of Aragon

explanation.surface: A model sort of peaceful residence suited to a woman named Catherine.
explanation.definitionFit: A paragon is a model of excellence, a perfect example of its kind.

clue.text: Something for the bed, which includes pole as a way to join ropes

parts.note: a sheet is bedding

indicators.note: includes signals one piece put inside the other

parts.note: which refers back to the bed just mentioned, so it stands for that word
N is the north pole

explanation.surface: Some bedding with a pole in it, apparently useful for tying ropes together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'which' points back to 'bed', giving BED a second time, with N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheet bend is a sailor's knot used for tying two ropes together.

clue.text: Fellow would be MC if you twisted his tail

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its end, so twisting it turns round only the last two letters

parts.note: a compere is a master of ceremonies

explanation.surface: A man who could turn into a master of ceremonies if you gave his tail a twist.
explanation.definitionFit: A compeer is an equal or companion, a fellow of the same standing.

clue.text: Animals eating snake's head have been cut short, as they should be

indicators.note: eating signals one piece holding the other inside it

parts.note: deer are animals

indicators.note: head picks the first letter of snake
cut short says the start of the word is clipped as in the contraction

parts.note: the word have, as in the contraction 've

explanation.surface: Animals that have eaten a snake's head and been cut down, as is only fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'been' is a link word. 'cut short' leaves VE, the contracted 've of 'have'.
explanation.definitionFit: To deserve something is to merit it, to be getting what one ought to get.

clue.text: Make a slight adjustment to time, say seven days

indicators.note: say means a word that sounds like the next piece

parts.note: seven days make a week

explanation.surface: Instructions to adjust a schedule a little, perhaps by a week.
explanation.definitionFit: To tweak is to adjust something finely, making a small change.

clue.text: I get worn out: it's disgusting, a sort of shirt getting worked into stuff

indicators.note: out says the letters of worn are put into a new order

parts.note: ugh is an exclamation of disgust
a T-shirt is a sort of shirt

explanation.surface: Someone complaining their worn-out shirt is disgusting.
explanation.definitionFit: Inwrought describes a pattern worked into fabric, as in embroidery.

clue.text: Sophisticated, which is not so good, and wildly wrong at heart

indicators.note: at heart says the anagram goes into the middle of the other piece

parts.note: worse means not so good

indicators.note: wrong says the letters of wildly are in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Being cultured is no virtue and badly mistaken deep down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'which is' and 'and' are link words; 'wrong' gives LDLYWI, and 'at heart' sends it into the middle of the worse piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Worldly-wise means experienced in the ways of the world and not naive.

clue.text: Cardinal wear inverted to cause ill-feeling

indicators.note: inverted says the two words of the cardinal's red hat swap places

parts.note: a hat is something to wear
red is the cardinal's colour

explanation.surface: A cardinal's headgear turned upside down provokes resentment.
explanation.walkthrough: A cardinal wears a red hat; 'inverted' swaps the words round, not the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Hatred is intense dislike, a strong form of hostile feeling.

clue.text: Stuff for backing unkind directors

parts.note: hard can mean unkind or harsh
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: Material used to support unpleasant company directors.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardboard is stiff fibre sheeting often used for the backs of furniture and pictures.

clue.text: Among Catherine's work is something that came down to her

definitions.text: something that came down to her

parts.note: among means in

indicators.note: to work dough is to knead it, so the letters of Catherine are kneaded into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Catherine's writings include an item handed down to her.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work' reads as a noun, her output, but it is a verb, knead, which jumbles CATHERINE to HERITANCE.
explanation.definitionFit: An inheritance is property passed down to an heir after a death.

clue.text: Dalit contrived to bid farewell to possible disaster

indicators.note: contrived says the letters of Dalit are rearranged

parts.note: to wave is to signal goodbye

explanation.surface: A Dalit manages to say goodbye in the face of possible catastrophe.
explanation.walkthrough: A Dalit is a member of India's lowest caste. 'contrived' turns DALIT into TIDAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal wave is a huge sea wave that can cause a catastrophe.

clue.text: Privilege given to the majority operationally

parts.note: a right is a privilege
handed to means given to

explanation.surface: A privilege granted to most people, as far as operations go.
explanation.walkthrough: Most people operate things with their right hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Most people use their right hand for tasks, so they are this way in how they operate.

clue.text: Soup I left — it hurt my mouth

parts.note: gumbo is a thick soup or stew from Louisiana

explanation.surface: A diner leaving the soup because it burnt their mouth.
explanation.definitionFit: A gumboil is a painful abscess on the gum, so a sore inside the mouth.

clue.text: See 14 across
Composer and Antarctic explorer in island

parts.note: James Clark Ross explored Antarctica; the Ross Sea is named after him
taken as written

explanation.surface: A musician and a polar explorer together on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Rossini was the Italian who composed The Barber of Seville and William Tell.

clue.text: Hymn to Liberty briefly rendered six times a year

indicators.note: rendered means performed in a new version, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: lib is the short form of liberty

explanation.surface: A short hymn to freedom performed every other month.
explanation.definitionFit: Bimonthly can mean every two months, which is six times a year.

clue.text: Sound number is a transcendental one

parts.note: taken as written
e, the base of natural logarithms, is a transcendental number

explanation.surface: A mathematical remark that a sound number is transcendental.
explanation.walkthrough: In mathematics a transcendental number is one that is not a root of any polynomial with whole-number coefficients; e and pi are examples.
explanation.definitionFit: Noise is a sound, especially a loud or unwanted one.

clue.text: Beam for one being idle, it's said

indicators.note: it's said means the following word is heard, not spelt

parts.note: a lazer is someone who lazes about

explanation.surface: A ray meant for someone lazing about, so people claim.
explanation.definitionFit: A laser produces a narrow, intense beam of light.

clue.text: Managed church as cattle farm

parts.note: to run something is to manage it, past tense ran

explanation.surface: Someone ran a church as if it were a livestock farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranch is a large farm for raising cattle, especially in the Americas.

clue.text: Boil has burst: delete

indicators.note: burst says the letters of the boil break apart and re-form

explanation.surface: A boil has popped and needs cleaning away.
explanation.definitionFit: To abolish is to do away with something completely, wiping it out.

clue.text: Enthusiastic staff that's been souped up

parts.note: hot on something can mean keen on it
a rod is a staff or stick

explanation.surface: A keen employee who has been given a boost.
explanation.definitionFit: A hot rod is a car modified for extra speed and power.

clue.text: Mixed with gin it makes other things new

parts.note: taken as written
alia is Latin for other things, as in inter alia

explanation.surface: Something that refreshes everything else once combined with gin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gin and Italian' (Italian vermouth, often shortened to 'gin and it') is a classic cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian vermouth is the drink traditionally mixed with gin in a gin and it.

clue.text: Died when little people didn't stop to investigate?

indicators.note: a word that doesn't come to a full stop loses its last letter

parts.note: elves are little people of folklore

explanation.surface: Someone died as the fairies kept going, prompting an inquiry.
explanation.definitionFit: To delve is to dig deeply, so to investigate thoroughly.

clue.text: Using that article, write out start of history

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: out says the letters of write are rearranged
start of picks the first letter of history

explanation.surface: Writing a story with a particular article, starting with its history.
explanation.definitionFit: Therewith is an old adverb meaning with that, or by means of that.
